title: Python Automation & Data Science Intern
description:
***Python Automation \& Data Science Intern***

Company: Leading Technology \& Data Solutions Company

Openings: 2 \| Duration: 6 Months \| Stipend: ₹12,000–₹15,000/month

Experience: Fresher / Entry Level \| PPO: Available based on successful completion

***Job Overview***

**We are looking for a motivated Python Automation \& Data Science Intern with basic to intermediate knowledge of Python, data analysis, Excel, and Machine Learning. The candidate should be able to use AI\-assisted coding tools while understanding, validating, debugging, and modifying the generated code independently.**

***Key Responsibilities***

\- Develop Python scripts for automation, data processing, Excel, and reporting.

\- Perform data cleaning, EDA, analysis, and visualization.

\- Work with Pandas, NumPy, and basic Machine Learning models.

\- Assist with regression, classification, clustering, train\-test split, and model evaluation.

\- Test, debug, document, and improve automation scripts.

\- Use AI coding tools such as ChatGPT, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot and validate the generated code.

\- Support real\-world data and automation projects based on business requirements.

Required Skills

\- Python – Basic to Intermediate

\- Pandas \& NumPy

\- Excel – Formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, PivotTables, Filters \& Formatting

\- Data Cleaning \& EDA

\- Data Visualization

\- Basic Machine Learning

\- Familiarity with Scikit\-learn, SQL, Power BI, Matplotlib/Seaborn is an advantage.

\- Strong logical thinking, problem\-solving, and willingness to learn.

***Eligibility***

Students or recent graduates from Computer Science, IT, Data Science, AI, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or related fields. Relevant academic/project experience in Python, Data Science, ML, or Automation is preferred.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: AI MLOPS/LLMOps Engineer
description:
Job Description: Seeking a strong Data Engineer / AI Engineer with expertise in building and operationalizing large\-scale AI and NLP solutions on cloud platforms. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience integrating AI/LLM models into production workflows, developing scalable data pipelines, and processing large volumes of multilingual unstructured text.


Key strengths should include:


* Proficiency in **Python and SQL** with experience deploying AI/NLP solutions such as **document classification, entity extraction, NER, PII masking, de\-identification, hybrid search, and LLM integrations** .
* Strong knowledge of **Apache Airflow** for orchestrating end\-to\-end data pipelines and automating batch processing workflows.
* Experience working with **AWS services** including S3, Athena, Glue, Fargate, EKS, SQS, and Step Functions.
* Capability to design and maintain large\-scale document processing systems handling complex JSON structures, embedded documents, and multilingual content.
* Familiarity with **vector search and retrieval systems** , including embeddings, pgvector, PostgreSQL/Aurora, GIN indexes, and full\-text search.
* Experience with **ML lifecycle management** using MLflow, Databricks/Azure Databricks, model deployment, monitoring, and evaluation frameworks.
* Strong DevOps practices including GitHub\-based development, CI/CD pipelines, schema management, and production support.

  
**Responsibilities: What You Will Do**

**AI Module Integration \& Inference Pipelines**

* Integrate and adjust inference pipelines for NLP modules including document classification, entity extraction, de\-identification (DEID), and LLM\-based early trend detection
* Connect DS\-coded AI modules into end\-to\-end production workflows via Airflow DAGs on AWS EKS
* Build and tune hybrid search pipelines combining GTE multilingual dense embeddings with GIN lexical search on Aurora PostgreSQL
* Integrate with OpenAI\-based API platform for multilingual query expansion and LLM\-driven trend detection

**Document Processing \& Parsing**

* Design and maintain document preprocessing pipelines that parse deeply nested JSON structures (emails with attachments, embedded PDFs) from S3/DataLake
* Handle multilingual unstructured text (English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Dutch, French, Italian) across 300 GB of claim notes and documents
* Build chunking strategies and metadata extraction for downstream embedding and retrieval workflows

**Data Pipeline Engineering**

* Author and maintain Airflow DAGs for batch processing (monthly entity refresh, trend detection, DEID pipeline)
* Manage data flow across AWS services: S3, Athena, Glue, Fargate, SQS, Step Functions
* Scale pipelines to handle 500K\+ claims and hundreds of millions of text chunks

**Production Deployment \& Quality**

* Deploy and version models using MLflow and Databricks
* Manage schema evolution and migrations using Liquibase on Aurora PostgreSQL
* Instrument pipelines with logging, monitoring, and evaluation scoring for retrieval quality

  
Qualifications: Area Skills
  

**Languages** Python (primary), SQL
  

**AI / NLP** LLM API integration, multilingual embeddings (e.g., GTE), hybrid search, text classification, entity extraction, NER, PII masking
  

Data Pipelines Apache Airflow, batch orchestration, large\-scale unstructured data processing
  

Cloud \& Infrastructure AWS (S3, Athena, Glue, Fargate, EKS, SQS, Step Functions)
  

Databases PostgreSQL / Aurora, pgvector, GIN indexes, full\-text search
  

ML Platform MLflow, Databricks / Azure Databricks
  

DevOps GitHub, CI/CD pipelines
  

Education
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Master's degree in Data Science, AI/ML, Computer Science, or Analytics is preferred but not mandatory.
* Relevant cloud or data engineering certifications are advantageous.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Data Scientist
Job Title: Senior Data Scientist, Executive Reporting Centre of Excellence  

  

Product Data \& Analytics is a centralized global team that enables Mastercard product business units to make better data‑driven decisions. We build internal analytics partnerships that strengthen focus on business performance, portfolio and revenue optimization, initiative tracking, new product development, and go‑to‑market strategies. These capabilities are underpinned by our data platforms that enable insights to be delivered in a standardized, scalable, and cost‑efficient manner.  

  

Role Summary  

We are seeking a highly analytical and business\-oriented Senior Data Scientist to drive enterprise\-level KPI reporting, business performance tracking, and strategic analytics initiatives across global business units and regions.  

The role will be responsible for owning end\-to\-end analytics solutions from requirement gathering, conceptualization, KPI framework design, data engineering, dashboard development, stakeholder alignment, finance automation, and ongoing commercialization of reporting solutions. The candidate will partner with global business leaders, Finance, FP\&A, data providers, and technology teams to transform complex business requirements into scalable analytical products that enable executive decision\-making. This role requires a unique combination of business acumen, technical expertise, product thinking, and team leadership capabilities.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

* Own and manage executive\-level KPI reporting across multiple business units, products, and regions.
* Design and implement scalable KPI measurement frameworks, reporting methodologies, and governance processes.
* Develop and maintain analytics solutions, dashboards, and reporting products using Tableau, Power BI, SQL, and Python.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and operational scalability.
* Lead finance automation initiatives that transform manual FP\&A reporting packs into governed, scalable, role\-based dashboards and financial intelligence layers.
* Partner with global stakeholders to gather requirements, define metrics, resolve reporting issues, and provide actionable insights.
* Monitor data quality, perform validations, and ensure accuracy of business\-critical reporting.
* Lead cross\-functional projects from conceptualization through implementation, commercialization, and business adoption.
* Translate complex business problems into data\-driven and AI\-enabled solutions for senior leadership.
* Evaluate, identify, and integrate GenAI and AI capabilities into existing products and business processes.
* Contribute to AI product roadmap planning by identifying opportunities for AI\-driven features, automation, insights generation, and user experience enhancements.
* Collaborate with technology teams to define AI solution architecture, integration requirements, data dependencies, and governance standards.
* Mentor and guide team members on technical tools, analytics best practices, AI adoption, and business processes.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, prioritize deliverables, and ensure timely execution of strategic initiatives.

  

  

  

Job Requirements  

* 4\+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Product Analytics, Product Management, or related fields.
* Experience designing and managing enterprise\-level KPI frameworks and executive reporting solutions with proven ability to build scalable analytics products and automate reporting processes.
* Experience automating finance or FP\&A reporting processes, including revenue, expense, driver, budget, forecast, and P\&L reporting, with strong understanding of financial data governance and validation.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, AI agents, and enterprise AI use cases.
* Experience evaluating, planning, and integrating AI capabilities into business products and analytical solutions.
* Understanding of AI solution architecture, data flows, API integrations, model governance, and deployment considerations.
* Ability to translate business requirements into product roadmaps and identify opportunities for AI\-driven innovation.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, data validation, performance measurement, and reporting governance.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working across global teams and senior leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, strategic thinking, and product planning capabilities.
* Experience working in Agile/Product\-oriented environments; CSPO, CSM, Product Management, AI, or Cloud certifications are preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
  

  

Who is Mastercard?  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

Overview  

The Security Solutions Data Science organization is looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager with an understanding of data science who is eager to take on the responsibility of managing a wide variety of data science projects. The person in this role will join a team of leading edge data scientists who are not just building models, but are working to solve fraud related problems for our customers through AI as a foundation for new product offerings.
  

  

Role  

The Technical Program Manager will interact with data scientists, product managers, engineers, and senior leaders across partner teams in the organization to deliver complex projects. You will define roadmap deliverables, develop execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, provide escalation management, make sound trade\-off decisions, and translate technical expressions into business terminology. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. You are expected to be detail\-oriented, with a solid technical background and excellent problem\-solving skills.  

All staff at Mastercard are expected to demonstrate 'Mastercard Way' cultural values every day \- own it, simplify it, sense of urgency, thoughtful risk\-taking, unlock potential, and be inclusive – with a relentless focus on our customers.
  

  

As a Senior Technical Program Manager for data science, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:  

* Primary liaison between product and data science, managing day\-to\-day planning and execution of data science projects through the entire engagement process, from business understanding through model deployment and monitoring
* Looked to as first point of contact for your teams or business line/service and the single source of truth for status, providing the correct information and associated data about the state of the project to the right audience at the right time with the right focus
* Build strong partnerships with product and technology teams and align esnure alignment with data science efforts
* Translate technical approaches and outcomes into business language
* Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program, or domain with depth to be credible and influential with teams they work with
* Clearly articulate scope, timelines, dependencies, owners, actions, risks, and mitigations. Report progress to teams and senior leadership in regular cadence, potentially representing segments of or the entire program
* Work with data scientists and engineering teams to build/improve ways of working and identify and mitigate risks or issues that may impact the plan
* Conducts meaningful retrospectives, creates action plans to implement changes at the team level

  

All about you  

It is not expected that any single candidate would have expertise across all these areas.  

* Experience with project management, operating autonomously across multiple teams, with demonstrated critical thinking, and thought leadership
* Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning, and building
* Help product, data science and engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. Identify blocking issues and manage their resolution
* Proven track record of data\-driven decision making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
* Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
* Excellent organization, interpersonal, administrative and problem solving skills
* Strong communication skills at all levels of the organization
* Capable of working independently but with a collaborative nature.
* Ability to navigate a matrix organization.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Analyst-Data Science
description:
The **Analyst, Data Science (30313\)** role sits within the **Model Risk Management Group (MRMG)** under the Global Risk and Compliance organization. The role supports the **independent risk management and governance of Generative AI and advanced Machine Learning models** across American Express.


This role focuses on the assessment and monitoring of **LLMs, GenAI applications, and ML‑based models** used in areas such as marketing, credit, fraud, customer engagement, operations, and risk decisioning. The analyst will contribute to strengthening enterprise model risk controls, elevating model excellence, and supporting compliance with **evolving regulatory and governance expectations** for AI systems.


The role requires strong analytical skills, curiosity in AI/ML technologies, and the ability to translate technical findings into clear, risk‑focused insights for stakeholders.


  
**Education**

* MBA or Master’s Degree in **Statistics, Economics, Data Science, AI/ML, Generative AI or related quantitative fields** from a top‑tier institute.

**Experience**

* **0–2 years** of experience in analytics, data science, model development, validation, or big‑data workstreams.
* Exposure to **AI/ML model development, testing, or validation** through professional experience, projects, or internships preferred.
* Interest in or early exposure to **Generative AI or LLM‑based systems** is a strong plus.

**Technical Skills**

* Foundational understanding of **AI/ML concepts** , with interest in Generative AI technologies.
* Hands‑on experience with at least one of **Python, PySpark, R, or SQL** .
Ability to work with data, perform analytical checks, and support model evaluation activities.  
* 

**Core Capabilities**

* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and structured‑thinking skills.
